article_added.title: A Chinese financial event knowledge graph-based retrieval-augmented generation framework for financial question answering
verified_claims: CFinRAG uses a Chinese financial event knowledge graph, query reconstruction, and dual-level retrieval.
The article reports a curated dataset of 1,200 Chinese financial research reports and 3,600 QA pairs.
article_added.scope_note: The comparison with this project is a synthesis of the published article and this manuscript: CFinRAG develops graph-based financial event QA; the current manuscript compares source-separated and merged retrieval for annual-report and regulation evidence under fixed settings.
